fusions.name: Ramming Run
fusions.desc: You rush to the target and heave into it, dealing 16 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Full Broadside
fusions.desc: Looses every link at once in a cone 8 tiles long, dealing 36 damage to everything caught in it. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Anchor Aweigh
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Steady Swell

riders.text: you cross it faster than ground
and nothing that has to wade can reach you

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you move 12% faster over it, from silver your stamina recovers 15% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.
